summary: Protect command cache when GitHub identity is unknown

delivery.outcome: Prevent shared GitHub command cache reads when credentials are not explicitly available for identity, while preserving explicit-token caching and independent protected publication.
nonGoals: Do not read credentials from the system keyring, change provider transport or alter the persistent cache schema.

architecture.decision: Bypass command caching when explicit GitHub tokens are absent, because GitHub CLI can authenticate through a credential store outside hosts.yml. Retain hashed token identity and cache behavior for explicit tokens.
architecture.rollback: Revert the protected source change; no cache database migration is required.

validation.evidence: Simulated hidden credential rotation bypasses cache; explicit-token identity caches and rotates without exposing credentials.
